props.animation_script:
(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][RunFront-SFX-Return]";

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const DEBUG = true;

const SOUND_SRC = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Damage3.ogg";

const IMPACT_VFX_SRC = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Weapon_Attacks/Melee/Group02/TrailAttack02_01_04_Regular_OrangeRed_800x600.webm";

const SOUND_VOLUME = 0.5;

const MOVE_OUT_MS = 320;

const HOLD_MS = 1500; // wait after impact before running back

const MOVE_BACK_MS = 320;

const APPROACH_GAP = 70;

function dbg(...args) {

if (!DEBUG) return;

console.log(TAG, ...args);

}

function warn(...args) {

console.warn(TAG, ...args);

}

function err(...args) {

console.error(TAG, ...args);

}

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = (eventName, eventPayload = {}, options = {}) => {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, eventPayload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload: eventPayload });

};

}

async function toTokenPlaceable(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (typeof ref === "string") {

const byId = canvas.tokens?.get(ref);

if (byId) return byId;

try {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

return doc.object ?? doc.token?.object ?? doc;

} catch (e) {

warn("toTokenPlaceable failed fromUuid:", ref, e);

return null;

}

}

return ref.object ?? ref.token?.object ?? ref ?? null;

}

function uniq(arr) {

return [...new Set(arr.filter(Boolean))];

}

function summarizeToken(tok) {

if (!tok) return null;

return {

id: tok.id ?? null,

name: tok.name ?? tok.document?.name ?? null,

uuid: tok.document?.uuid ?? null,

center: tok.center ? { x: tok.center.x, y: tok.center.y } : null,

x: tok.x ?? null,

y: tok.y ?? null

};

}

async function resolveSourceToken() {

const candidates = [

payload.casterTokenUuid,

payload.sourceTokenUuid,

payload.performerTokenUuid,

payload.tokenUuid,

payload.sourceTokenId,

payload.casterTokenId,

globalThis._token?.document?.uuid,

globalThis.token?.document?.uuid

];

dbg("resolveSourceToken candidates:", candidates);

for (const c of candidates) {

const tok = await toTokenPlaceable(c);

if (tok) return tok;

}

return canvas.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

async function resolveTargetTokens() {

const raw = uniq([

...(Array.isArray(payload.targetTokenUuids) ? payload.targetTokenUuids : []),

...(Array.isArray(payload.targetUUIDs) ? payload.targetUUIDs : []),

...(Array.isArray(payload.originalTargetUUIDs) ? payload.originalTargetUUIDs : []),

...(Array.isArray(payload.targets) ? payload.targets : []),

...(Array.from(game.user?.targets ?? []).map(t => t?.document?.uuid))

]);

dbg("resolveTargetTokens raw refs:", raw);

const out = [];

for (const r of raw) {

const tok = await toTokenPlaceable(r);

if (tok) out.push(tok);

}

return out;

}

let resolvedSourceToken = null;

let resolvedTargets = [];

try {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

const sourceToken = await resolveSourceToken();

const targets = await resolveTargetTokens();

const firstTarget = targets[0] ?? null;

resolvedSourceToken = sourceToken;

resolvedTargets = targets;

dbg("Resolved source token:", summarizeToken(sourceToken));

dbg("Resolved targets:", targets.map(summarizeToken));

dbg("Payload snapshot:", payload);

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("No caster token found.");

return;

}

if (!firstTarget) {

ui.notifications.warn("No target token found.");

return;

}

ONI.emit("oni:animationStart", {

type: "oni.runFrontSfxReturn",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: targets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

const scriptSource = `

const { casterToken, targetTokens, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Need casterToken");

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;

}

function animateXY(obj, from, to, durMs) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * e;

obj.y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * e;

if (t >= 1) {

ticker.remove(update);

resolve();

}

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

function getNativeFlipX(token) {

const values = [

token?.document?.texture?.scaleX,

token?.mesh?.scale?.x,

token?.icon?.scale?.x

].filter(v => typeof v === "number");

if (values.some(v => v < 0)) return true;

const mirrorX = token?.document?.texture?.mirrorX;

if (typeof mirrorX === "boolean") return mirrorX;

return false;

}

function setSpriteFlipX(sprite, flipped) {

const sx = Math.abs(sprite.scale.x || 1);

sprite.scale.x = flipped ? -sx : sx;

}

async function createClone(token) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

const home = { x: token.center.x, y: token.center.y };

sprite.x = home.x;

sprite.y = home.y;

if (baseObj) {

sprite.width = Math.abs(baseObj.width);

sprite.height = Math.abs(baseObj.height);

sprite.alpha = baseObj.worldAlpha ?? 1;

sprite.rotation = baseObj.rotation ?? 0;

}

sprite.zIndex = Number(params.zIndex ?? 5000);

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

setSpriteFlipX(sprite, getNativeFlipX(token));

return sprite;

}

const activeFx = new Set();

async function playImpactVfx(targetToken, src) {

if (!targetToken || !src) return;

let sprite = null;

let cleaned = false;

const cleanup = () => {

if (cleaned) return;

cleaned = true;

try {

const source = sprite?.texture?.baseTexture?.resource?.source;

if (source && typeof source.pause === "function") source.pause();

} catch (_) {}

try {

if (sprite?.parent) sprite.parent.removeChild(sprite);

} catch (_) {}

try {

sprite?.destroy();

} catch (_) {}

activeFx.delete(sprite);

};

try {

const texture = await loadTexture(src);

sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

activeFx.add(sprite);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

const center = targetToken.center ?? { x: 0, y: 0 };

const maxDim = Math.max(targetToken.w ?? 100, targetToken.h ?? 100);

const width = Number(params.impactVfxWidth ?? (maxDim * 2.4));

const height = Number(params.impactVfxHeight ?? (width * 0.75));

sprite.x = center.x;

sprite.y = center.y;

sprite.width = width;

sprite.height = height;

sprite.alpha = Number(params.impactVfxAlpha ?? 1);

sprite.rotation = 0;

sprite.zIndex = Number(params.impactVfxZIndex ?? ((params.zIndex ?? 5000) + 1));

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

const media = texture?.baseTexture?.resource?.source;

if (media) {

try {

media.muted = true;

media.loop = false;

media.currentTime = 0;

} catch (_) {}

if (typeof media.play === "function") {

const playPromise = media.play();

if (playPromise?.catch) playPromise.catch(() => {});

}

if ("onended" in media) {

media.onended = () => cleanup();

}

}

const durationMs =

Number.isFinite(media?.duration) && media.duration > 0

? Math.ceil(media.duration * 1000) + 50

: Number(params.impactVfxFallbackMs ?? 900);

await wait(durationMs);

cleanup();

} catch (e) {

console.error("[ONI][Anim][RunFront-SFX-Return][PseudoVFX] Failed to play impact VFX:", e);

cleanup();

}

}

const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

const originalFlipX = getNativeFlipX(casterToken);

const home = { x: casterToken.center.x, y: casterToken.center.y };

const target = targetTokens?.[0] ?? null;

let sprite;

try {

sprite = await createClone(casterToken);

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

let front = {

x: home.x + Number(params.fallbackDx ?? -120),

y: home.y

};

if (target) {

const targetCenter = target.center ?? { x: home.x, y: home.y };

const approachDir = home.x >= targetCenter.x ? 1 : -1;

const gap = Number(

params.approachGap ??

Math.max(casterToken.w ?? 100, target.w ?? 100) * 0.6

);

front = {

x: targetCenter.x + (approachDir * gap),

y: targetCenter.y

};

}

// Run in

setSpriteFlipX(sprite, originalFlipX);

await animateXY(

sprite,

home,

front,

Number(params.moveOutMs ?? 320)

);

// Play target impact VFX right when the caster reaches the target.

if (target && params.impactVfxSrc) {

playImpactVfx(target, params.impactVfxSrc);

}

// Hold while the impact window plays

if (Number(params.holdMs ?? 0) > 0) {

await wait(Number(params.holdMs ?? 0));

}

// Flip for the run back

setSpriteFlipX(sprite, !originalFlipX);

await animateXY(

sprite,

front,

home,

Number(params.moveBackMs ?? params.moveOutMs ?? 320)

);

} finally {

for (const fx of Array.from(activeFx)) {

try {

const source = fx?.texture?.baseTexture?.resource?.source;

if (source && typeof source.pause === "function") source.pause();

} catch (_) {}

try {

if (fx?.parent) fx.parent.removeChild(fx);

} catch (_) {}

try {

fx?.destroy();

} catch (_) {}

}

activeFx.clear();

if (sprite) {

canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite);

sprite.destroy();

}

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

}

`;

dbg("Starting pseudo movement session.");

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "oni.runFrontSfxReturn.flipAware",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [firstTarget.document.uuid],

params: {

moveOutMs: MOVE_OUT_MS,

holdMs: HOLD_MS,

moveBackMs: MOVE_BACK_MS,

approachGap: APPROACH_GAP,

fallbackDx: sourceToken.center.x >= firstTarget.center.x ? -120 : 120,

zIndex: 5000,

impactVfxSrc: IMPACT_VFX_SRC,

impactVfxFallbackMs: 900,

impactVfxWidth: Math.max(firstTarget.w ?? 100, firstTarget.h ?? 100) * 2.4,

impactVfxHeight: Math.max(firstTarget.w ?? 100, firstTarget.h ?? 100) * 1.8,

impactVfxAlpha: 1,

impactVfxZIndex: 5001

},

meta: {

source: "RunFrontSfxReturn",

soundSrc: SOUND_SRC,

impactVfxSrc: IMPACT_VFX_SRC

}

});

// Sequencer handles SFX only.

dbg("Starting Sequencer SFX.");

const sfxSeq = new Sequence();

sfxSeq

.wait(MOVE_OUT_MS)

.sound()

.file(SOUND_SRC)

.volume(SOUND_VOLUME);

sfxSeq.play();

// Wait for the whole cinematic window before ending.

await wait(MOVE_OUT_MS + HOLD_MS + MOVE_BACK_MS + 80);

dbg("Animation wait window finished.");

} catch (e) {

err("Animation crashed:", e);

} finally {

try {

ONI.emit("oni:animationEnd", {

type: "oni.runFrontSfxReturn",

sourceTokenId: resolvedSourceToken?.id ?? null,

targetTokenIds: resolvedTargets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

dbg("Emitted oni:animationEnd.", {

sourceTokenId: resolvedSourceToken?.id ?? null,

targetTokenIds: resolvedTargets.map(t => t.id)

});

} catch (e) {

err("Failed to emit animationEnd:", e);

}

}

})();
props.custom_logic_resolution:
const TAG = "[CL-RES][IP-DRAIN-2]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

const args = globalThis.__ARGS ?? p?.__confirmArgs ?? {};

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

const userActor = await context.helpers.getAttackerActor();

if (!userActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing user actor.");

return;

}

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

if (!targetUuids.length) {

console.warn(TAG, "No targets found.");

return;

}

const accTotal = Number(p?.accuracy?.total ?? args?.accuracyTotal ?? NaN);

const hasAccuracy =

(typeof args?.hasAccuracy === "boolean") ? args.hasAccuracy : !!p?.accuracy;

const autoHit = !!(args?.autoHit || p?.advPayload?.autoHit || p?.accuracy?.isCrit);

const escapeHTML = foundry?.utils?.escapeHTML ?? ((v) => String(v ?? ""));

const getDef = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const row = p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot?.perTarget?.find(r => r?.uuid === targetUuid);

return Number(row?.defense ?? targetActor?.system?.props?.defense ?? 0) || 0;

};

const isHit = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const targetDef = getDef(targetUuid, targetActor);

if (!hasAccuracy) return true;

if (autoHit) return true;

if (!Number.isFinite(accTotal)) return false;

return accTotal >= targetDef;

};

const getUserTokenName = () => {

if (typeof _token !== "undefined" && _token?.name) return _token.name;

return userActor?.name ?? "User";

};

const getTargetDisplayName = (targetDoc, targetActor) => {

return targetDoc?.name ?? targetActor?.name ?? "Target";

};

async function postStealFeedbackHtml(innerHtml) {

const FLAG_SCOPE = "fabula-ultima-companion";

const FLAG_KEY = "oniHideChatHeader";

let hookId = null;

hookId = Hooks.on("renderChatMessage", (message, html) => {

if (!message?.getFlag?.(FLAG_SCOPE, FLAG_KEY)) return;

html.find(".message-header").remove();

html.find(".message-sender").remove();

html.find(".message-metadata").remove();

html.find(".message-avatar").remove();

html.find(".chat-portrait-container").remove();

html.find(".chat-portrait-message-portrait").remove();

html.find(".chat-portrait-image").remove();

html.find("img.chat-portrait").remove();

Hooks.off("renderChatMessage", hookId);

});

await ChatMessage.create({

user: game.user.id,

type: CONST.CHAT_MESSAGE_TYPES.OTHER,

speaker: { alias: "" },

content: `

${innerHtml}

`,

flags: {

[FLAG_SCOPE]: {

[FLAG_KEY]: true

}

}

});

}

for (const targetUuid of targetUuids) {

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(targetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

if (!targetActor) continue;

const userTokenName = getUserTokenName();

const targetName = getTargetDisplayName(targetDoc, targetActor);

const targetDef = getDef(targetUuid, targetActor);

const hit = isHit(targetUuid, targetActor);

console.log(TAG, "HIT CHECK", {

user: userActor?.name,

userTokenName,

target: targetActor?.name,

targetName,

accTotal,

hasAccuracy,

autoHit,

targetDef,

hit

});

if (!hit) {

await postStealFeedbackHtml(`Fail to steal anything.`);

continue;

}

const targetIpBefore = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(targetActor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

const userIpBefore = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(userActor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

const userMaxIp = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(userActor?.system?.props?.max_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

const requestedSteal = 2;

// The steal amount depends only on the target's current IP.

// Even if the user is already at max IP, the target still loses IP.

const actualSteal = Math.min(requestedSteal, targetIpBefore);

if (actualSteal <= 0) {

console.log(TAG, "No IP stolen", {

user: userActor?.name,

userTokenName,

target: targetActor?.name,

targetName,

requestedSteal,

targetIpBefore,

userIpBefore,

userMaxIp

});

await postStealFeedbackHtml(`Fail to steal anything.`);

continue;

}

const targetIpAfter = Math.max(0, targetIpBefore - actualSteal);

// User gain is clamped by max IP, but does not affect the steal amount.

const actualGain = Math.min(actualSteal, Math.max(0, userMaxIp - userIpBefore));

const userIpAfter = Math.min(userMaxIp, userIpBefore + actualGain);

await targetActor.update({

"system.props.current_ip": String(targetIpAfter)

});

await userActor.update({

"system.props.current_ip": String(userIpAfter)

});

console.log(TAG, "IP TRANSFER APPLIED", {

user: userActor?.name,

userTokenName,

target: targetActor?.name,

targetName,

requestedSteal,

actualSteal,

actualGain,

targetIpBefore,

targetIpAfter,

userIpBefore,

userIpAfter,

userMaxIp

});

await postStealFeedbackHtml(

`${escapeHTML(userTokenName)} steals ${escapeHTML(actualSteal)} IP from ${escapeHTML(targetName)}!`

);

}

props.custom_logic_action:
const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][FRESH-TURN->BONUS+5]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

return;

}

const combat = game.combat;

if (!combat) {

console.log(TAG, "No active combat. Skipping.");

return;

}

p.meta = p.meta || {};

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

const targetUuids =

Array.isArray(p?.originalTargetUUIDs) && p.originalTargetUUIDs.length

? [...p.originalTargetUUIDs]

: Array.isArray(p?.meta?.originalTargetUUIDs) && p.meta.originalTargetUUIDs.length

? [...p.meta.originalTargetUUIDs]

: Array.isArray(p?.targets) && p.targets.length

? [...p.targets]

: [];

const firstTargetUuid = targetUuids[0] ?? null;

if (!firstTargetUuid) {

console.log(TAG, "No target. Skipping.");

return;

}

const td = await fromUuid(firstTargetUuid);

const targetDoc = td?.document ?? td;

const targetActor = td?.actor ?? td;

if (!targetActor) {

console.log(TAG, "Could not resolve target actor. Skipping.", { firstTargetUuid });

return;

}

const getTokenId = (doc) =>

doc?.token?.id ??

doc?.id ??

doc?.document?.id ??

null;

const getSceneId = (doc) =>

doc?.parent?.id ??

doc?.document?.parent?.id ??

null;

const getCombatantForDoc = (docLike, actorLike) => {

const ref = docLike?.document ?? docLike;

const tokenId = getTokenId(ref);

const sceneId = getSceneId(ref);

const actorId = actorLike?.id ?? ref?.actor?.id ?? ref?.id ?? null;

let c = combat.combatants.find(cmb => {

const cSceneId = cmb.sceneId ?? cmb.parent?.scene?.id ?? cmb.scene?.id ?? null;

const cTokenId = cmb.tokenId ?? cmb.token?.id ?? null;

return tokenId && cTokenId === tokenId && (!sceneId || !cSceneId || cSceneId === sceneId);

});

if (c) return c;

c = combat.combatants.find(cmb => (cmb.actor?.id ?? null) === actorId);

if (c) return c;

return null;

};

const targetCombatant = getCombatantForDoc(targetDoc, targetActor);

if (!targetCombatant) {

console.log(TAG, "No combatant found for target. Skipping.", {

target: targetActor?.name ?? firstTargetUuid

});

return;

}

const currentActs = Number(

targetCombatant.getFlag?.("lancer-initiative", "activations.value") ??

targetCombatant.flags?.["lancer-initiative"]?.activations?.value ??

NaN

);

const maxActs = Number(

targetCombatant.getFlag?.("lancer-initiative", "activations.max") ??

targetCombatant.flags?.["lancer-initiative"]?.activations?.max ??

NaN

);

let hasNotTakenTurnYet = false;

let mode = "none";

if (Number.isFinite(currentActs) && Number.isFinite(maxActs)) {

hasNotTakenTurnYet = (maxActs > 0 && currentActs === maxActs);

mode = "current===max";

} else if (Number.isFinite(currentActs)) {

hasNotTakenTurnYet = (currentActs > 0);

mode = "fallback current>0";

}

if (!hasNotTakenTurnYet) {

console.log(TAG, "Target has already acted this round. No bonus.", {

target: targetActor?.name ?? firstTargetUuid,

currentActs,

maxActs,

mode

});

return;

}

const beforeBonus = Number(p.advPayload.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

p.advPayload.bonus = beforeBonus + 5;

p.meta.freshTurnBonusDamage = {

applied: true,

amount: 5,

targetUuid: firstTargetUuid,

targetName: targetActor?.name ?? firstTargetUuid,

currentActs,

maxActs,

mode

};

console.log(TAG, "APPLIED", {

target: targetActor?.name ?? firstTargetUuid,

currentActs,

maxActs,

mode,

bonusBefore: beforeBonus,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

});
